title: Concept: Redis error detail disclosed in a response
description: A Redis NOAUTH error on an unauthenticated connection in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The reply proves the endpoint reached Redis without credentials, which means the network path to the store is open from the request handler.
applicability: Deployments that render a Redis NOAUTH error on an unauthenticated connection into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The reply proves the endpoint reached Redis without credentials, which means the network path to the store is open from the request handler.
